    for u, v, w in roads:
        graph[u].append((v, w))
        graph[v].append((u, w))

    # Prim's algorithm
    visited = [False] * n
    min_cost = 0
    heap = [(0, 0)]  # (cost, node)

    while heap:
        cost, node = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if visited[node]:
            continue
        visited[node] = True
        min_cost += cost
        for neighbor, weight in graph[node]:
            if not visited[neighbor]:
                heapq.heappush(heap, (weight, neighbor))

    # Check if all cities are connected
    if sum(visited) != n:
        return -1
    return min_cost
